Config.EmptyHint: Detected BepInEx .cfg files and MelonLoader Loader.cfg appear on the left. Select one to inspect and edit settings by section.
Config.NoEntries: No editable key/value entries were recognized in this file. You can still use Open file for manual editing.
Config.NoFiles: No editable configuration files were detected. BepInEx mods often need to run once before their .cfg file is created.
Config.RestartHint: Some settings only take effect after the game or mod is restarted. HTF Manager will not write configuration files while the game is running; keep the default if you do not understand a setting.
Config.Search: Search config name, GUID, file path or setting...
Config.Subtitle: Manage BepInEx mod settings and MelonLoader loader settings inside HTF Manager. Local backups can be created automatically before saving.
Config.Title: Configuration
Discover.CardBody: A later release will add search, dependency resolution, one-click install and update checks.
Discover.Empty: No mods match the current filters.
Discover.Failed: Could not load the mod catalog.
Discover.Subtitle: Browse How to Fish mods from Thunderstore and install, update and resolve dependencies directly.
Discover.Title: Discover
Drop.Subtitle: Drop a .zip, .dll, .htfprofile, or .htfbundle file here.

Home.Subtitle: Overview of your How to Fish mod environment.
Home.Title: Home
Inspector.LoaderMissingText: This mod requires {0}, but the current environment is not ready. HTF Manager can download and install it from the official source.
Inspector.NoFiles: This package has no files that need to be written directly to the game directory.
LoaderSetup.ManualBep: For manual setup, download BepInExPack from the official source and place the BepInEx folder, winhttp.dll and doorstop_config.ini next to How to Fish.exe.
LoaderSetup.ManualMelon: For manual setup, download the Windows x64 archive from the official Releases page and place the MelonLoader folder, version.dll and dobby.dll next to How to Fish.exe.
LoaderSetup.MixedWarning: The other mod loader is also ready. Both loaders may exist on disk, but mixed runtime use can cause Harmony or game-patch conflicts. HTF Manager will not enable mixed mode automatically.
LoaderSetup.SafetyText: Automatic setup only uses trusted official sources and goes through cache, staging, path validation, backup and rollback. Unknown existing bootstrap files are never overwritten automatically.
LoaderSetup.Subtitle: Install, validate, repair or uninstall a mod loader.
Mods.DropHint: Drop a .zip, BepInEx .dll, or MelonLoader .dll anywhere in the window; HTF Manager will detect the loader and install path automatically.
Mods.ExternalHint: External mods can be enabled or disabled, but HTF Manager will not uninstall them.
Mods.ManagementHint: Managed mods are tracked by HTF Manager for files, updates, and uninstall; external mods are only detected and toggled and will not be deleted by the manager.
Mods.RestartHint: Enable/disable changes take effect the next time the game starts.
Mods.Subtitle: Install, enable, disable, update and uninstall How to Fish mods.
Mods.Title: Mods
Ops.BepInExNotReady: This mod requires BepInEx, but the BepInEx environment is not ready.
Ops.ConfigGameRunning: The game is running. Exit the game before saving configuration so the game or loader does not overwrite the changes.
Ops.EnvironmentNotReady: A valid How to Fish game directory was not found.
Ops.GameRunningBlocked: The game is running; mod files cannot be changed right now.
Ops.LoaderUninstallSuccess: Mod loader uninstalled; user mods and settings were preserved
Ops.MelonLoaderNotReady: This mod requires MelonLoader, but the MelonLoader environment is not ready.
Ops.ModDisabled: Mod disabled; the change takes effect on the next game launch.
Ops.ModEnabled: Mod enabled; the change takes effect on the next game launch.
Ops.NoUpdateSource: No online update source is known for this mod.
Ops.UnsupportedFile: Only .zip and .dll mod imports are supported.
Profiles.AddExistingHint: Select an installed mod not yet included in this profile
Profiles.Empty: No profiles yet. Enter a name and save the current state to create one.
Profiles.ModMissing: This mod is not currently detected
Profiles.Name: Profile name
Profiles.NoMods: This profile contains no mods. Applying it disables other installed mods without uninstalling them.
Profiles.SelectHint: Select a profile to inspect and edit the mods included in it.
Profiles.Subtitle: Manage isolated mod sets with optional configuration snapshots. Removing a mod from a profile never uninstalls it.
Profiles.Title: Profiles
Settings.AutoEnableDescription: Newly installed mods are enabled for the next game launch.
Settings.BackupBeforeSaveDescription: Create a local copy of the old configuration every time settings are saved from the Configuration page.
Settings.ConfigBackupsDescription: HTF Manager can preserve the previous version of a mod or loader configuration before writing changes.
Settings.HideDeprecatedDescription: Hide packages marked Deprecated by Thunderstore on the Discover page.
Settings.KeepCacheDescription: Keep local and Thunderstore packages for updates and recovery.
Settings.KeepLoaderCacheDescription: Cache BepInEx / MelonLoader archives downloaded by HTF Manager for repair and reinstall.
Settings.LanguageDescription: The change is immediate and saved to the local settings.json file.
Settings.MaxConfigBackupsDescription: Older backups are automatically removed after this limit is reached.
Settings.ModManagementDescription: Choose the default behavior for new installs, cache and uninstall operations.
Settings.PreserveConfigDescription: Do not delete user settings under BepInEx/config when uninstalling a mod.
Settings.ShowInspectorDescription: Preview loader, files, dependencies, conflicts and risk before local or Discover installs.
Settings.StorageDescription: Settings, profiles and cache are stored separately from the game directory.
Settings.Subtitle: Preferences are stored locally and restored on the next launch.
Settings.Title: Settings
Status.GameMissing: Game not detected. Select the game directory on the Tools page.
Tools.BepDescription: Used by most Thunderstore / BepInEx mods.
Tools.MelonDescription: Used by some MelonLoader / Nexus mods.
Tools.Subtitle: Inspect the game installation, BepInEx, MelonLoader and required files.
Tools.Title: Tools
Config.LoaderCaution: This is a loader configuration. Changes can affect all mods, the loading process, or game startup. Keep the default if you do not understand a setting. HTF Manager will not write configuration files while the game is running.
Config.NotLocalized: This third-party setting has no built-in HTF Manager localization. The mod author's original name and description are shown unchanged.
Config.RestartRequired: This setting fully takes effect after restarting the game.
Config.Safety.Title: Configuration safety notice
Config.Safety.Subtitle: Please read this before changing loader or mod settings.
Config.Safety.Body1: Changing loader or mod configuration can affect game stability, mod compatibility, multiplayer behavior, or the mod loading process.
Config.Safety.Body2: If you do not understand what a setting changes or what the consequences may be, do not change it casually and prefer the default value.
Config.Safety.Body3: HTF Manager can create a local backup before saving, but it cannot guarantee the behavior, compatibility, or configuration safety of third-party mods.
Config.Safety.LocalOnly: Acknowledgement is stored only in the local settings.json. This notice version will not be shown again after acknowledgement.
Settings.AdvancedDescription: Controls advanced presentation options in HTF Manager. Developer Mode only reveals technical information; it does not disable install, path, or file safety protections.
Settings.DeveloperModeDescription: Off by default. When enabled, Configuration additionally shows raw keys, sections, value types, Plugin GUIDs, source files, and other technical details. When disabled, only basic information needed for normal use is shown.
Profiles.ConfigSnapshotDescription: Snapshots include configuration files associated with mods in this profile only. BepInEx and MelonLoader loader settings are excluded. Current target files are backed up before a profile snapshot is applied.
Profiles.NoConfigSnapshot: This profile currently stores mod enabled states only. You can create a snapshot from the current mod configuration files at any time.
Ops.ProfileUnsavedConfig: Configuration Center has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before saving or applying a profile.
Profiles.SnapshotSkipped: Not in profile; skipped when applied
Profiles.MissingDescription: This shared profile references mods that are not currently detected. To avoid applying an incomplete environment, the profile cannot be applied until these mods are matched again or removed from the profile requirements.
ProfileImport.Title: Import profile
ProfileImport.Subtitle: Inspect mod references and configuration snapshots in a shared profile, then import it as a new local profile.
ProfileImport.Name: Imported profile name
ProfileImport.MissingText: {0} mod(s) could not be matched to the current installation. The profile can still be imported safely, but cannot be applied until those requirements are resolved or removed.
ProfileImport.NoBinaries: Shared profiles never include or redistribute mod DLLs or archives. They contain mod references, enabled states, and optional configuration snapshots only.
Ops.ProfileMissingRemoved: Missing mod requirement removed from profile
Ops.ProfileHasMissingMods: This profile still has {0} missing mod(s). Install and resolve them, or remove the corresponding requirements first.
ProfileImport.ImportWithVersionMismatch: Importable, but some installed mod versions differ from the shared profile
Restore.Title: Profile Restore Assistant
Restore.Subtitle: Review how each missing mod can be restored. Automatic items always go through Package Inspector before any files are changed.
Restore.CatalogErrorDescription: The restore plan cannot safely classify Thunderstore requirements until the catalog is available. Retry after checking your network connection.
Restore.CatalogErrorFooter: No restore decisions were made because the Thunderstore catalog could not be loaded.
Restore.CompleteDescription: This profile is ready to apply. Closing this assistant does not apply the profile automatically.
Restore.CompleteFooter: Restore complete · return to Profiles to apply the profile when ready.
Restore.FooterSummary: {0} of {1} missing requirement(s) can continue through Package Inspector.
Restore.ExplainReady: An exact trusted identity/version candidate is available and can be inspected before installation.
Restore.ExplainFallback: The requested version is not downloadable. The selected fallback is shown explicitly and will still require Package Inspector confirmation.
Restore.ExplainUnavailable: No safe automatic restore candidate is available from the current Thunderstore catalog. HTF Manager will not guess by mod name.
Restore.ExplainManual: This requirement is not eligible for automatic Thunderstore restore and must be restored manually.
Restore.WarningDeprecated: Warning: this Thunderstore package is marked deprecated.
Restore.WarningInactive: Warning: the selected version is marked inactive.
Restore.ConfirmFallback: I understand the requested version is unavailable and want to inspect this fallback version.
Restore.EnvironmentRequired: Select a valid How to Fish game directory before inspecting or installing restore candidates.
Restore.GameRunning: The game is running. Restore candidates can be reviewed, but package inspection/install is disabled until the game exits.
Health.Title: Profile Health
Health.Subtitle: Compare this profile's expected Mod environment with the currently installed environment. Health inspection is read-only.
Health.NoVersionRepair: v0.3.7 detects this version drift but does not automatically replace, upgrade, or downgrade an installed Mod.
Health.MissingFooter: Missing expected Mods block profile Apply. Use Restore missing mods to inspect available recovery sources.
Health.WarningFooter: The profile can still be applied, but version drift or uncertain legacy identity remains visible as a warning.
Health.HealthyFooter: The currently installed environment satisfies all tracked profile expectations.
Share.Title: Share Profile
Share.Subtitle: Choose a lightweight profile or a full portable bundle. Full sharing only includes verified HTF-managed source artifacts that exactly match the profile expectation.
Share.LightweightDescription: Share only the profile definition and optional configuration snapshots. Missing Mods can be restored from providers or manually on the receiving machine.
Share.FullDescription: Create a .htfbundle containing the profile plus eligible verified package artifacts. Opening the bundle never installs Mods automatically.
Share.SafetyNote: External/unmanaged Mods, loaders, dependency closure, and drifted versions are not bundled automatically. Only share package artifacts you have permission to redistribute.
Share.Footer: You can review the generated file before sending it. The receiver still confirms every Mod installation through Package Inspector.
BundleImport.Title: Import Portable Profile Bundle
BundleImport.Subtitle: HTF Manager reads and validates the embedded profile first, compares it with the current environment, and only then exposes bundled payloads for missing Mods.
BundleImport.OpenRestore: Open Restore Assistant after importing so I can review missing Mod recovery options.
BundleImport.SafetyNote: Importing the profile does not install bundled Mods. Every bundled package still requires explicit Package Inspector confirmation.
Ops.ProfileBundleExportFailed: Could not export portable profile bundle
Ops.ProfileBundleImportFailed: Could not import portable profile bundle
Restore.ExplainBundle: The exact expected package artifact is available in the imported .htfbundle. It will be extracted lazily, verified, and sent through Package Inspector before installation.
Restore.ExplainCatalogUnavailable: Thunderstore is currently unavailable and this requirement has no exact bundled payload. Retry the catalog later or restore it manually.
